verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage claims in-product AI agents that surface insights and recommend next steps, plus AI-generated summaries and trend-spotting across session replays and heatmaps. However, all of this comes from marketing copy, with no in-depth product documentation or hands-on corroboration; the MCP server serves external assistants and is not credited as in-product. missing for 10: first-party docs detailing the in-product AI insights/agents feature, evidence of how suggestions are generated and delivered across core reports (funnels, retention, flows), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
Use AI to spot trends across hundreds of replays and heatmaps
Diagnose what changed, and why, in seconds, delivered as a dashboard you and your team can keep working from.
